# TheoryFirst_NoExperiment_Paradigm

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A research positioning strategy that abandons experimental validation in favor of a purely theoretical physics/applied mathematics approach, targeting theory-oriented journals. Shifts the contribution from empirical demonstration to fundamental understanding, which is critical for establishing rigorous foundations in emerging TCC/iNEST fields.
